note: M2's instance and device halves on the console. The Vulkan instance is created (vkCreateInstance -> 0, the three instance extensions vkQuake asks for) and the physical device is enumerated and created (Vendor AMD, Device 'PS5 AGC GPU (ps5vk)', vkCreateDevice -> 0, with VK_KHR_swapchain enabled). The run then stops inside device initialisation on the depth-stencil format gap, which is the open blocker recorded in docs/ACTIVE.md and reported in docs/PS5_VULKAN_REQUESTS.md R1. The capture is the newest run only: the console opens trace.txt for append, so the file holds every run since deployment and --tail 46 selects this one.

human_check: This capture records the run stopping as much as it records it starting, and both halves are deliberate. The first six needles are M2's instance and device halves; the seventh is a failure the driver owns, asserted rather than merely noted so the record cannot keep claiming a pass once the behaviour changes. When ../PS5_Vulkan reports a combined depth-stencil format, this capture and its expectation must both be replaced, because the run should then continue past device initialisation into its render passes. The must_not_contain needle is a separate regression guard: if the title loses its game data again, W_LoadWadFile appears and this record goes red.
